question: Who transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs described as good eaters?
premises: The recipients are the earth-moving yoginīs.
They are described as good eaters.
inference: The teaching was told to the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The instrumental form bhūcarī is unusual and may reflect textual variation.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told to the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
